The twenty-sixth edition of the [[ATP Masters]] Series.<ref>[https://www.atptour.com/en/scores/results-archive?year=2015&tournamentType=1000 ATP Masters 2015] atptour.com.</ref> The champion of each Masters event is awarded 1,000 rankings points. Novak Djokovic won a record 6 titles in a season and reached a record 8 finals in a season.
